question: Which surah reassures the Prophet (pbuh) that his enemies will be cut off and forgotten?

english_translation: Indeed, We have granted you abundance—Al-Kauthar
question: What does ٱلْكَوْثَرَ mean in Surah Al-Kauthar?

options.B: The punishment of the People of the Elephant
options.C: The blessings granted to the Prophet (pbuh) and response to his critics
options.D: The importance of charity and prayer

english_translation: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice
question: What two actions is the Prophet (pbuh) commanded to perform in Surah Al-Kauthar?

english_translation: For he who hates you—he is the one cut off
question: What key concept does Surah Al-Kauthar establish about those who opposed the Prophet (pbuh)?

options.A: They will be given a chance to repent
options.B: They will be the ones cut off without legacy
options.C: They will face punishment in this life only
options.D: They will be forgiven if they seek guidance
